messages:
kevin: quick alert — after the kernel-select 2.1 rollout to canary we saw a host-side p99 jump on ingress (42ms -> 78ms) and CPU sys% up ~22%. Looks correlated with small-write path.
anya: :eyes: saw that, grabbing flamegraphs now. Initial diff shows way more writev syscalls during tokenization/parse stage.
maria: KV-cache telemetry also shows higher eviction churn on those hosts (hot shard -> spill). Could be amplification from more small fragments hitting kvcache and triggering async writes.
kevin: repro snippet from prod logs (truncated):
```
GRPC WRITEV len=3 bytes=512,102,24 -> flush
tokenize: emit 64b chunk
parse: push proto frame
```
kevin: we used to coalesce those tiny chunks earlier in the proxy layer; kernel-select change nudged batching window down.
sam: interesting — kernel selection picked a low-latency kernel path for the majority, which reduced batching tolerance. We probably tightened the minibatch window unintentionally.
anya: flamegraph: host-side stack shows tokenization -> writev -> epoll_wait (blocked) -> retry. Attachments: flame link https://perf.redwood/internal/fg/2998882222 :thinking:
perf-bot: CI perf snapshot posted: https://ci.redwood/pipelines/8823/snapshots/2998882222 (compare vs 2998879000)
josh: can we pin canary back or patch to coalesce small writes on ingress proxy? Which is less risky?
maria: short-term: enable coalesce-smallwrites=true on proxy (runtime flag). Long-term: change kernel-selector to prefer kernels that allow slightly longer batching windows for write-bound ingress.
sam: proposed quick patch:
```
- batching.window_ms = 2
+ batching.window_ms = 6
- kernel_hint = low_latency
+ kernel_hint = balanced
```
kevin: measured locally: window_ms=6 brings p99 down to ~46ms, CPU sys falls ~14%. KV evict rate drops ~30% in sampler run.
anya: +1 to runtime flag flip, roll to canary, observe for 30m. I'll own the roll.
josh: please post rollback plan and metrics dashboard to the incident channel once canary starts.
kevin: plan: flip coalesce-smallwrites=true on canary hosts at 2998882300, watch p99/cpu/kv-evict for 20m, then promote. If p99 > 60ms or errors spike > 0.5% revert.
maria: I'll add a kvcache metric alert for hotshard-evict-rate > 5/s during the window.
anya: making the change now. tagging @sam for kernel hint follow-up after stabilization. :hammer_and_wrench:
kevin: thanks. leaving notes in the PR with the microbench numbers and flamegraph link.
